preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string S is either a lowercase Latin letter or a digit.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(S.count(c) * (S.count(c) - 1) for c in set(S))
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of ordered pairs (i, j) such that S[i] = S[j].
